newsitem.title: JAPAN: Payment for 1/3 JR West shares not made -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Payment for 1/3 JR West shares not made -- paper.

text.p: Payment for about one-third of the shares in West Japan Railway Co (JR West) to be publicly offered was not made, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said that it conducted a survey on securities houses and they said payment of about 20 to 40 percent of publicly offered JR West shares was not made by the payment date set for the end of last week.
Shares in JR West, part of the formerly state-owned Japan Railways group, will be listed on Japanese bourses on October 8. Of the JR West shares, 950,000 will be publicly offered.
